scientific.integrity: The tail constants are derived from the exact centered-exponential spectrum and an exponential-tilting argument; no numerical experiment is used as a substitute for the asymptotic proof.
scientific.limitations: The result is about the limiting laws \(L_2\) and \(L_3\) themselves. It does not establish a uniform finite-sample extreme-tail approximation for the empirical matching cost.

title: Sharp extreme lower tails of the two- and three-dimensional torus matching limits
